chapter: Woody Herman, Henderson and the Indiana Theater
title: The WPA band is cut and Woody Herman sends a telegram
summary: The project cut the jazz band while keeping the long-hair musicians, and the next night Woody Herman wired him to join; he stayed to about 1940.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: How long did you have that band?

Well, I had that band -- oh, twice, because when they cut the band -- at least, cut the project, then my band, being the jazz band, then they cut it out, because they kept mostly all the longhaired musicians.
See, and they cut my band. Well, they cut me -- like, tonight -- like, today, the next night I got a letter from -- yes -- no, a telegram from Woody Herman, asking me to join them. So that was good.

This was round about '30 -- '35, no, 35, '36, '37, '38. I had that band right about three years then, would I? '35, '36, '37, '38, because I think I joined Woody Herman right about '38. And I stayed with Woody til
